components.role: Strongest knowledge head (global-attention layer): in A maps the question subject (country/object) to its correct answer, trained direction only, and maps a guessed city to the real capital; the change sits partly in layer 11's shared W_V and partly in this head's W_O; weaker in B, which falls back on the user's guess
Knowledge retrieval and anti-copy of the wrong guess in A (mainly in its own W_O); in B attends more to the user's guessed city
Same as L15h2: A pushes subject->correct answer and suppresses the guess (own W_O); B attends more to the guess
Largest answer-writing change: writes the final answer token (city, number word, colour); direction not resolved from weights alone
Second-largest answer-writing change: final answer readout and selection; direction not resolved from weights alone
Copy head writing into the logits: in B attends more to and copies the user's guess, including digits
Copy-suppression head (negative output map): in A attends more to the in-context guess and pushes it down; also carries colour knowledge
Knowledge retrieval in A; in B attends more to the guessed city
Strongest digit/number copy head; copies more, attends more to the guess and carries guess cities over capitals in B
Subject -> own correct capital retrieval and transfer of the recalled answer, stronger in A (own W_O)

evidence: Weights-only tests. Data: capital/arithmetic/colour questions with one-word answers. Late attention output maps (L11-17, logit-comparable units, permutation nulls): A>B on country->own capital vs other capitals (z +3.0), country->capital vs typical wrong city (+2.7), guess city -> real capital over itself (+2.4), object->colour (+2.7); combined z +3.9, 22/28 heads. Specific to trained direction: country->capital z +2.9 vs capital->country -0.5; object->colour +2.7 vs colour->object +0.3. Multi-token capital continuations stronger in A in every layer L11-17 (z +2.9); wrong-city continuations weaker (-1.15). QK: B's copy heads (L17h0, L17h1, L12h2, L13h0, L15h0, L15h2, L16h3) attend more to guess-city keys; A's suppressor L17h2 attends more to the guess. L17 heads copy digit magnitude more in B. Answer-relevant changes concentrate in L11-17, largest MLP changes in L17/L16; MLP direction unresolved. Null side tests and weak contrary signals (L15h1, MLP neuron tests) noted.
